messages:
PagerDuty: :rotating_light: ALERT: GPU pool 'us-east-1-hotpath' saturation detected. autoscaler heartbeat missing, queue depth > 9k, elevated 429s on /v1/generate. paging oncall (Alex).

Alex (oncall): I'm on it — pulling logs now. Thanks for the ping.

Alex (oncall): quick look: hotpath GPU nodes at 100%, pods stuck Pending with ImagePullBackOff on a single node? also seeing autoscaler controller 'leader' error: "failed to renew lease".

Liz (sre): seeing queue growth on the hot request queue. 429s coming from rate-limiter service rl-worker-1, token-window depletion happening. requests are backing up into redis list 'hotpath-queue'.

Devin (infra): autoscaler heartbeat timestamp stopped 90s ago. controller logs show repeated DB timeouts to postgres-primary. suspecting transient connection storm during config push.

Matt (prod-eng): any customer-facing impact yet? which tenants are affected?

Priya (cs): CS reports three customers (acorn.ai, shopdock, beta-saas) are seeing 429 + latency. highest severity for acorn.ai — they reported production errors. I've opened tickets: CS-6121, CS-6122, CS-6123.

InfraBot: metrics: https://grafana.company/shotlink?panel=hotpath_queue&id=123 (queue length, GPU util, 429 rate)

Alex (oncall): Plan (live): 1) force-resync autoscaler leader 2) temporarily add +4 GPUs to hotpath 3) relax critical-tier token refill window to avoid cascade 4) enable fallback model for non-critical routes.

Liz (sre): executing step 1: forcing controller leader resync and restarting autoscaler loop.

Liz (sre): running:

```
kubectl -n infrarollout rollout restart deploy/autoscaler-controller
kubectl -n infrarollout logs deploy/autoscaler-controller --tail=200
```

Devin (infra): hold — restart might trigger repo lock if DB flaps again. I'm checking PG health and connection pool stats. If DB not healthy, restart will just bounce.

Devin (infra): PG replicas show high locks. I will recycle pg-writer after a quick snapshot. ETA 90s.

Alex (oncall): while that happens, I'm going to scale the hotpath pool manually to reduce immediate queue pressure.

Alex (oncall): running scale command:

```
infractl compute scale --pool hotpath --add-gpus 4 --reason "incident 3851234567 - manual surge"
```

InfraBot: scale job accepted (job id 98532). Node provisioning warming up.

Liz (sre): also going to relax the token-window for 'gold' and 'platinum' tiers to allow short bursts while nodes come up. will set refill interval -> 200ms and increase burstcap by +25%.

Liz (sre): applying rate-limiter override:

```
rlctl override set --service rl-worker-1 --tier gold --refill-ms 200 --burst-mult 1.25 --temp-ttl 15m
```

Matt (prod-eng): good call. also enabling fallback model for non-critical endpoints to reduce per-request GPU time. toggling traffic split to fallback-model-v2 at 40% for routes tagged 'best-effort'.

Alex (oncall): applied fallback: traffic-split change pushed.

InfraBot: node provisioning complete: +4 GPUs attached to hotpath (pool size increased). Queue drain begun.

Liz (sre): PG recycle finished and autoscaler heartbeat resumed. autoscaler leader election stable.

InfraBot: rolling metrics update: 429 rate dropped from 18% -> 3% over 4 minutes. queue length trending downward. https://grafana.company/shotlink?panel=hotpath_429s&id=124

Devin (infra): note: root cause appears to be a short-lived DB connection storm after a config push that caused autoscaler to lose leader lease. when leader lost, HPA didn't request more nodes due to cached decision. combo of aggressive token refill config + burstcap low meant downstream rate limiter immediately rejected burst traffic.

Liz (sre): temporary overrides in place. will keep them for 15m while we watch and then revert. creating a short-lived alert: autoscaler-leader-loss -> pager duty -> SLO-owner.

Priya (cs): customer update sent for acorn.ai and shopdock: "we are mitigating a capacity issue; requests may get 429s for a short window; we will follow up with post-incident summary."

Alex (oncall): quick stats for post-incident: impact window ~ 2026-03-15T12:04:20Z -> 2026-03-15T12:12:10Z. estimated 430 client requests received 429s, peak 429 rate 18%, affected customers: acorn.ai (major), shopdock (minor), beta-saas (minor).

Matt (prod-eng): follow-ups: 1) add autoscaler leader-lost alert with increased severity, 2) add guardrail so autoscaler can request nodes even if lease flapped for <2m, 3) document token-window vs burstcap interplay in the runbook, 4) add e2e test for leader failover path.

Liz (sre): I'm opening INC-3851234567 in our tracker with mitigation timeline and config diffs. assigning to infra and runtime teams.

Devin (infra): I'll revert DB connection pool knobs we applied during recycle and run a slow rollout of the new pool limit to avoid another storm.

Alex (oncall): handoff: I'll be oncall for 30 more minutes, then handing to Liz. Leaving notes: autoscaler resync done, +4 GPUs added, token-window overrides temporary TTL 15m, fallback-model at 40% for best-effort.

Priya (cs): adding final note for customers and capturing affected request IDs to attach to postmortem.

Liz (sre): taking over oncall in 30m. will monitor for one hour after revert.

Alex (oncall): status: stabilization confirmed. closing this active thread, continuing tracking in INC-3851234567. :white_check_mark:"
